name: Cherry Temple
living: cherry blossom petals drift down across the whole frame (petals weather) and settle on the dirt
the pink cherry trees sway gently in the breeze (crown mask, slow vertex wobble)
the stone lanterns flicker like candles, warm and soft (glow mask)
the pagoda's lit windows glow and breathe warmly, one tier dimming now and then
the setting sun's halo pulses softly and a slow glint slides down the pagoda spire
low mist drifts through the valleys of the purple mountains behind the pagoda
the lilac pixel clouds drift slowly across the dusk sky
light-tower lamp banks glow and breathe, moths drifting through their cones
a few fireflies blink over the garden rocks beyond the wall
the scoreboard's little diamond icon pulses, and its lamps tick over after each home run
note: fences in m at spray -45 (lf) / 0 (cf) / +45 (rf) deg, optional lcf / rcf at -22.5 / +22.5; wallHeight = the painted wall's height (m) at the fence (qa.py --wall-height); wallProfile (optional) = spray ranges where the painted wall is much taller/shorter; living = suggested living-painting details for this park (masks, sprites, shaders)
